# CipherFlux Labs

> CipherFlux Labs (CipherFlux) is an AI and software technology company building next-generation intelligent software products, custom full-stack web applications, business process automations, and AI agents.

## Core Products
- **Atlyra**: AI-powered interview preparation platform providing real-time audio analysis, mock interviews, and behavioral performance insights.
  - URL: https://smith-ai-five.vercel.app
- **Svanexa AI**: AI women's wellness application delivering cycle tracking, pattern analytics, and health guidance with privacy-first encryption.
  - URL: https://hersync-ai.vercel.app

## Services & Solutions
CipherFlux Labs provides end-to-end client engineering and automation services:
1. **Business Workflow & AI Automation**:
   - Multi-step automated workflows (Make.com, Zapier, n8n, webhooks).
   - WhatsApp & Website AI customer support bots.
   - Intelligent document parsing and OCR (invoices, receipts, legal docs).
   - Starter packages starting from ₹3,500 – ₹18,000 / $45 – $220 with monthly maintenance retainers.
2. **Full-Stack Web & AI Application Development**:
   - Custom MVP and SaaS development (React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, Supabase, PostgreSQL).
   - Payment gateway integration (Stripe, Razorpay) and subscription management.
   - Custom RAG pipelines and vector database integrations for private knowledge bases.
   - Complete project builds starting from ₹18,000 – ₹89,000+ / $220 – $1,100+.
3. **Monthly Maintenance & System Support**:
   - 24/7 uptime monitoring, error logs review, security updates, and dedicated developer hours starting at ₹1,500 – ₹12,000 / month ($20 – $150 / mo).

## Core Operating Policies
- Client retains 100% IP rights upon full payment.
- External infrastructure costs (hosting, API keys) are held on client-owned accounts.
- Transparent milestone schedule (50% upfront, 50% on live demo/handover).
